messages:
Devon: heads-up — rolling hotfix v0.9.3 into prod at 19:30 PT. We need two approvals before the 19:15 cutoff to avoid rollback.
Sara: pinging @kevin @aj — can you give quick eyes? smoke passes locally, small migration script.
Kevin: looking now. what's the migration duration? does it lock anything?
Devon: migration is a no-lock alter, ~8s per shard, run during canary, rollback path is 'downversion' script in tools/migrations.
Aj: I can review but will be afk for 20m, can approve if no schema changes. patch looks fine at glance.
Sara: QA smoke is green on canary (https://ci.redwood.test/build/893) :white_check_mark:
Kevin: left two tiny comments in PR #8984 — one nit and one around null handling. won't block if Aj signs off.
Aj: pushed a commit addressing null handling, running unit tests now.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window opens 19:30 PT. cutoff for approvals: 19:15 PT. Current approvals: 1/2.
Devon: if we don't hit 2 by cutoff we can ask ops to flip 'automerge-override' but that needs release-lead signoff.
Sara: @Lina (release lead) can you confirm if we can use override at cutoff if aj isn't back? :pray:
Lina: I can authorize override in emergency but prefer waiting 10 more minutes. stand by.
Aj: tests passed, approving now. :thumbsup:
Sara: great — that's 2/2. I'm merging in 30s unless any objections.
Kevin: good from me.
Devon: merging and kicking canary. monitor dashboards please — I'll watch latency and errors channel.
Sara: canary looks fine so far. no errors in logs.
deploy-bot: canary success, promoting to full. :rocket:
Devon: thanks team! tagging in release notes and update on #all-hands later.
